requirements: Explicit serial shared-host resource assignment; do not run heavy recipes concurrently
Existing Linux-arm64 Podman VM and already present exact MAGE carrier image ID from recipe.json; no package installation, random latest, user-store or default-connection change
Exact existing 8B and 0.6B model paths/SHA-256 identities from recipe.json; never substitute a different requested model

Repeat from a new isolated clone at the pre-finalization source SHA recorded in finalization-source.json, using new run-output names. That frozen source has no prior root finalizer receipts/index; scripts intentionally refuse to overwrite old evidence. Do not rerun finalizer in the already finalized delivery tree
Owned acquired binary copies are disposed after qualification, so reacquire the same pinned public release/layers to repeat; published metadata/digests and selected raw artifacts remain retained
If the clone path differs, change only recipe.archive to its new owned acquired-copy path before freezing inputs; this necessarily changes the recorded config hash

release_acquisition.precondition: Create the new owned .acquired directory only; hash verification is mandatory and also enforced by qualifier

scope: Actual Linux VM CPU endpoint controls plus nonexecuting amd64 image contents; no production, G1, legal, managed-profile, quality or clean-performance acceptance
